name: Cubing 4 Kids 2018

venue.name: iWerx
venue.address: 1520 Clay St, North Kansas City, MO 64116
venue.details: Follow the signs to get into the venue. There is also a huge parking lot outside the venue.

information:
* We encourage new competitors to attend and compete. 

* The base fee for the competition is $10 (United States Dollar), and a new, unwrapped children's toy.

* All competitiors are required to bring a new, unwrapped children's toy.

* There will be an 80 competitor limit.

* Located at iWerx

* All proceeds are going to Operation Breakthrough

* Check out[ FAQ](https://worldcubeassociation.org/faq) for questions

* [Directions](https://www.google.com/maps/dir/My+location/iWerx,+1520+Clay+St,+North+Kansas+City,+MO+64116/data=!4m6!4m5!1m0!1m2!1m1!1s0x87c0f0b9d08d5ba9:0x1ddbba8074d95472!3e0?sa=X&ved=0ahUKEwjA9qvK8YDYAhWZ3oMKHcsACwMQox0INzAA) here

**Lunch, Food and Drinks**
* We will be serving pizza for $1.50 a slice.

* There will be two vending machines with sodas if you want to get some.
